messages:
Deepa (PM): quick sync — product wants a small console card for 'cost per 1k tokens' plus a breakdown showing cache vs batch savings and a routing-cost delta. need runtime + infra telemetry contract so we can ship a first iteration next sprint. who can own the feed?
Ben (eng-runtime): I can kick off a proposal. current events include: model, tokens_in, tokens_out, seq_len, cache_hit, batch_size, route_tag, gpu_ms. we don't emit amortized gpu_cost yet.
Alice (eng-platform): console needs hourly and daily rollups per route/model. prefer pre-aggregated counts for fast dashboards. also need per-route quota burn rate for alerts.
Carlos (eng-infra): we can provide gpu_seconds and infra_alloc tags per request. mapping gpu_seconds -> $/1k tokens needs a throughput baseline (tokens/sec per model/shape). we can publish a small lookup table per model+quant profile.
Erin (product): UX ask: show an "expected cost per 1k tokens" (single number) and an expandable "savings breakdown" with: cache saved %, batch saved %, routing premium/discount. example: $0.35 / 1k (cache: -$0.05, batch: -$0.07, routing: +$0.02). keep it simple for first ship.
Deepa (PM): good example. we also need TTL for the lookup — what retention do we need for audit? 90 days ok?
Ben (eng-runtime): 90 days fine for analytics. for realtime billing/cost alerts keep 30 days hot. big question: how do we compute "cache saved" at the request level? we have cache_hit boolean and cached_prefix_len, but savings depend on whether prefix was reused across requests in same session.
Alice (eng-platform): suggest we compute two signals server-side: (1) effective_tokens_charged (tokens actually produced + non-cached tokens) and (2) theoretical_tokens_if_no_cache (approx tokens if cache miss). then cache_savings = theoretical - charged. store both in telemetry.
Ben (eng-runtime): agree. example event fields (proto):
```
{
  model: "redwood-alpha-7b",
  tokens_in: 32,
  tokens_out: 128,
  effective_tokens_charged: 120,
  theoretical_tokens_no_cache: 200,
  cache_hit: true,
  batch_size: 8,
  route_tag: "hosted-standard",
  gpu_ms: 45
}
```
Carlos (eng-infra): once we have gpu_ms, infra can map to $ via monthly amortization + power + network. I'll produce a small script that takes gpu_ms, model_throughput, and infra_rate -> $/1k tokens. will attach calculation doc.
Erin (product): question: for quota UX, if a route has a high batch_savings but violates latency SLOs, we want to show both cost and latency tradeoffs. can we add latency p95 per route to the rollup?
Alice (eng-platform): yes; add latency_p50/p95/p99 to rollups. also add request_count and error_count. that will let product show a small sparkline.
Deepa (PM): ownership: Ben to draft telemetry contract (fields + semantics) by EOD Wed. Carlos to draft cost-mapping script + sample numbers by Fri. Alice to outline dashboard rollup specs and retention by next Mon. Erin will provide final UX copy by next Tue.
Ben (eng-runtime): noted. I'll post a PR with schema + sample event mapping. BTW we should include a boolean field `sampled` for high-volume clients to indicate downsampled events.
Alice (eng-platform): and a rate-limit/ingest pattern: if events > X rps for a route, switch to thin-sample + periodic full rollup. detail that in spec.
Carlos (eng-infra): FYI: infra cost numbers will vary by region; include region tag in events.
Deepa (PM): agreed. include region, tenant_tier (free/prod/enterprise), and model_variant in schema.
infra-bot: deploy: telemetry-proto-v2 pushed to canary cluster at 1962500400 — no errors reported.
Erin (product): :thumbsup: this looks good. small ask — can we compute an "expected monthly spend for 1M tokens" using current mix? might help sales.
Carlos (eng-infra): I can run the lookup with typical mixes and return a table. will include 1M token numbers for common routes.
Deepa (PM): perfect. last ask — please call out any gaps that block rollout (privacy, PII in prompts, extra KMS).
Ben (eng-runtime): gap: we must ensure telemetry doesn't contain raw prompts. we'll only emit token counts and hash ids. add a privacy checkbox in schema.
Alice (eng-platform): gap: storage costs for high-cardinality route_tag values. we'll recommend controlled vocabulary.
Deepa (PM): thanks all. will consolidate and send calendar invite for sync after Ben's PR.
Ben (eng-runtime): PR link when ready: <https://git.internal/redwood/telemetry/pulls/42>
Alice (eng-platform): adding shortlist of dashboards components to the ticket.
Deepa (PM): closing loop — target ship window for first dashboard: next sprint end (2 weeks).
Erin (product): noted, will prepare screenshots.
Carlos (eng-infra): will attach cost-sheets and scripts to the ticket.
Deepa (PM): :white_check_mark: thanks team.
